.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
root = Path.cwd()
manifest = root / 'docs/kernel/reviews/R4-manifest.sha256'
verified = []
for line in manifest.read_text().splitlines():
    digest, name = line.split(maxsplit=1)
    name = name.removeprefix('*')
    p = Path(name)
    if p.is_absolute():
        p = p.relative_to(root)
    if p.parts[0] in {'src', 'tests'} or str(p) in {'pyproject.toml', 'uv.lock'}:
        actual = hashlib.sha256((root / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        assert actual == digest, f'Changed after R4: {p}'
        verified.append(f'{actual}  {p}')
(root / 'docs/kernel/reviews/E-source-manifest.sha256').write_text('\n'.join(verified) + '\n')
print(f'R4 production/test/config hashes unchanged: {len(verified)} files')
PY
